# ScramStates

*Common*

Named string, boolean and number values that are saved with the world: global ones from `c.getServer().getStates()`, per player or NPC from `getStates()` of the entity.

## Methods

### setString {#setstring}

::: member

Stores a text, replacing any value the state had.

```js
c.getPlayer().getStates().setString("class", "mage");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | state name, like `"quest.stage"` |
| `value` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | text |

:::

### getString {#getstring}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | state name, like `"quest.stage"` |

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — the text of the state

:::

### setBoolean {#setboolean}

::: member

Stores true or false, replacing any value the state had.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | state name, like `"quest.stage"` |
| `value` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | value |

:::

### getBoolean {#getboolean}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | state name, like `"quest.stage"` |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — the value of the state

:::

### setNumber {#setnumber}

::: member

Stores a number, replacing any value the state had; NaN is ignored.

```js
c.getServer().getStates().setNumber("round", 1);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | state name, like `"quest.stage"` |
| `value` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | number |

:::

### getNumber {#getnumber}

::: member

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | state name, like `"quest.stage"` |

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — the number of the state

:::

### add {#add}

::: member

Adds to a number state; a missing state, or one that is not a number, counts as 0.

```js
var states = c.getServer().getStates();

states.add("total_spending", 20);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | state name |
| `value` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | number to add, negative to subtract |

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — the new value

:::

### removeMasked {#removemasked}

::: member

Removes the states matching a mask.

```js
// Remove all states that start with "regions."
c.getServer().getStates().removeMasked("regions.*");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mask` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | state ID; a trailing `*` matches any ending |

:::

### clear {#clear}

::: member

Removes all states.

:::
